title: Towing company advertising: channels and budgets

facts.fact: Adwave's towing advertising mix starts at $30 a day, with ads made from the business's website (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: With Adwave, that mix starts at $30 a day, with ads made from your website.

facts.fact: Adwave's daily budgets run from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription and no contract.
facts.quote: Adwave daily budgets run from $30 to $10,000, with no subscription and no contract.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's table, a $30 daily budget covers TV, Google Search, Facebook and Instagram, and web and mobile placements, with 30 active days totaling $900.
facts.quote: $30 | TV, Google (Search included), Facebook and Instagram, web and mobile | $900

facts.fact: Per Adwave's table, a $35 daily budget adds Reddit, with 30 active days totaling $1,050.
Adwave's pricing page gives a planning example of a $75 daily budget with more room per channel, totaling $2,250 over 30 days.
facts.quote: | $75 (pricing page planning example) | Same mix with more room per channel | $2,250 |

facts.fact: Per Adwave's table, a $91 daily budget makes TikTok available as an opt-in, with 30 active days totaling $2,730.
facts.quote: | $91 | TikTok becomes available as an opt-in | $2,730 |

facts.fact: Adwave's TikTok channel is opt-in and starts from about $91 per day.
facts.quote: TikTok | Short video for younger local drivers | Opt-in, from about $91/day |

facts.fact: The 30-day totals in Adwave's budget table are planning figures, and a business can pause before 30 days and pay only for what runs.
facts.quote: The 30-day totals are planning figures. You can pause before 30 days and you’re charged only for what runs.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $0.38 per image for extra creative beyond the included campaign creative.
facts.quote: extra creation costs $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $6 per social video for extra creative creation.
facts.quote: extra creation costs $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $6 per 15-second TV spot for extra creative creation.
facts.quote: extra creation costs $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Adwave charges $12 per 30-second TV spot for extra creative creation.
facts.quote: extra creation costs $0.38 per image, $6 per social video, $6 per 15-second TV spot and $12 per 30-second TV spot.

facts.fact: Card deposits to Adwave's prepaid wallet add a processing fee shown at checkout, while ACH deposits have no added fee.
facts.quote: Card deposits add the processing fee shown at checkout; ACH deposits have no added fee.

facts.fact: On a live Adwave campaign, a new daily budget applies the same day if the wallet covers it, with no proration.
facts.quote: On a live campaign, a new daily budget applies the same day if your wallet covers it, with no proration.

facts.fact: Per Adwave's table, Reddit ads are included, but availability depends on budget.
facts.quote: | Reddit | Reach local and car-focused communities | Included; availability depends on budget |
